column1: # Time budgets — expected durations, and when to stop waiting
# Every long operation gets an expectation. An operation that exceeds its `expected`
# is a finding to diagnose, not something to keep waiting on. An operation that
# `source` is `measured` (observed on this box, value in this file), `unmeasured`
# (a placeholder cap — the first use must record the real number here), or
# `derived` (arithmetic from measured bandwidth, shown in the note).
# Rule of thumb: expected is the number you would be surprised to exceed; cap is the
# number at which continuing to wait is itself the error.
